issue: 600 ids appear twice; copies differ only in emp_title capitalization (528) and dti by ≤0.01 (600)
reason: Same loan entered twice; keeping both would double-count it. Differences are formatting/rounding, and the label and amounts never differ
Parsed each format explicitly to month precision; all parse, no day/month swaps
Same rule as issue_d; all values parse

issue: State written as full name (652) or code not in upper case (1,311)
reason: Mapped names to two-letter codes and upper-cased; 0 unrecognized. Kept for fairness analysis; likely excluded from the model as a location proxy

issue: Amount recorded 10× too large: 280 above the 40,000 limit + 20 within it
reason: Installment is exactly 1/10 of the payment the stated amount requires (ratio 0.100); installments are typical and no loan shows a wrong installment, so the amount is the corrupted field. 20 errors were within the valid range and found only by the installment cross-check

issue: Income entered in thousands (values below 1,000, median 63.5)
reason: Raw values make yearly payments exceed income in 100% of these rows; ×1,000 gives median 63,500 and payment share 7.7%, matching other loans (65,000, 7.4%). Clean gap between these values and real incomes

issue: Negative utilization (sign flipped)
reason: With the sign removed, values agree with revol_bal ÷ total_rev_hi_lim as often as normal rows (97.3% vs 96.1% within 5 points)

issue: Negative utilization (sign flipped), in different loans from revol_util
reason: Cannot be recalculated; with the sign removed the median (68 vs 67) and the correlation with revol_util (0.835 vs 0.834) match normal rows, while the recorded values correlate at -0.835

issue: DTI above 40: 4 rows in training (all joint applications); 41 in the 2016 holdout, including individual loans; max 100.09 (training) and 126.8 (holdout)
reason: High DTI is plausible for joint applications; individual loans above 40 appear only in 2016, suggesting a policy change, reported as drift

issue: Upper FICO bound below the lower bound (values swapped)
reason: In all 150 rows low − high = 4, mirroring the normal high − low = 4 (29,848 rows), so the two values were swapped

issue: First credit line dated after the loan was issued (impossible)
action: set to missing + flag (impute in A4)
reason: Dates fall 1–23 months after issue with no constant shift (not recoverable); spread across all raw formats (not a parsing error); borrowers have normal account counts (median total_acc 24), so the date is wrong, not the history

issue: Installment inconsistent with amount, rate and term (ratio 0.50–1.07), not ×10
reason: Term swap explains none; in 8 the rate is >2 points from its sub-grade's usual rate (vs 1 of ~29,990 other loans), so the rate is likely wrong, but the true value cannot be recovered. 11 rows cannot materially affect the model

issue: Extra column not in the brief; equals 'recoveries > 0' from servicing (post-default)
reason: Default rate 100% when set (4,207/4,207) vs 5.5% otherwise; matches servicing recoveries exactly. Present in holdout but cannot exist at application time

issue: Label checked against servicing: no contradictions; 1 defaulted loan repaid ≥99% of principal
reason: Fully paid loans all repaid full principal, have no recoveries or settlement; settled loans all defaulted. The 1 case is plausible (interest/fees unpaid). Servicing also confirms the ×10 loan_amnt fix (243 paid loans: principal share = 1.0)

issue: Free text: 15,657 distinct values (13,327 after normalizing); 40% of rows unique; synonyms (rn / registered nurse)
reason: Too many unique values to use as a category; case/punctuation variants and synonyms split the same job

issue: Free text largely duplicating purpose: 63% identical; 83–93% share one title per purpose (wedding 30%)
reason: Adds little beyond purpose; missing for 276 holdout rows (5.5%) vs 8 in training

issue: ZIP first digit inconsistent with state
reason: Format valid for all rows; similar rate in untouched holdout (3/5,000) suggests real causes (moves, mailing address). Cannot tell which field is wrong; location is excluded from the model and addr_state is used for regional fairness analysis

issue: Joint applications rise from 16 in training (0.05%) to 96 in holdout (1.9%)
action: flag; report as drift; recommend manual review
reason: 16 training examples are too few to learn joint-application risk; they also explain most DTI values above 40

issue: 'wedding' appears in training but not in the 2016 holdout
reason: Rare level absent from later data; no new categories appear in the holdout

issue: extreme but genuine values
reason: recomputed revol_bal/total_rev_hi_lim matches exactly (e.g. 2,566/700 = 366.6%); formula agrees within 5 pts for 96.2% of loans

issue: implausible extreme incomes
reason: $7.5M sales rep (Verified) and $1.25M imply typical DTI (20, 18.2) at 100x/10x lower income; suspected extra zeros, not provable, so capped not corrected
